# Application system — Copilot entry point

Read [START-HERE.md](../START-HERE.md), then [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
Use the shared [system guide](../docs/SYSTEM.md),
[workflows](../docs/WORKFLOWS.md), and [handoff](../docs/HANDOFF.md).
Candidate facts live in `bank/experience-bank.json`; application state/events
live in `tracker/tracker.json`. Preserve stable IDs, update supported records,
regenerate views, validate, and publish requested changes. Drafts do not prove
submission or sending. All preferences and factual rules remain in the shared
Markdown handbook; do not maintain separate Copilot-only instructions.
